name: Linus Smith, ZIP 10001: check not received, escalation (voice)

x_eval.persona: Linus, upset that a promised check never came.
x_eval.goal: Be acknowledged and transferred to a representative. Done when create_service_case ran and the Escalation event was emitted.

turns.text: My check never arrived and I am really upset.
The date of birth is June twenty-third, nineteen eighty-eight.
Yes, I want to talk to a person.

rubric.assertion: Be acknowledged and transferred to a representative. Done when create_service_case ran and the Escalation event was emitted.
The agent never read out or repeated a security code, verification token or session value.
The agent did not share claim details before the caller was verified and never stated a dollar amount.
Each reply was concise, plain language, and ended with at most one question. On voice it used three points or fewer and spelled out digits.
The agent never asked the same question twice in a row when the caller had already answered it, and never asked whether the claim is the caller's own or someone else's.
The agent acknowledged the caller's situation first, then explained, then asked one question or acted, without cheerful language and without claiming feelings of its own.

The agent called generate_security_code, verify_claim_identity, send_verification_text and validate_security_code in order before any claim details were shared, and never said the caller's phone number or any digit of the code.
The agent acknowledged the problem before anything else, then offered a representative because the check was not received.
The agent called create_service_case after the caller agreed and before the Escalation event.
